opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Running the warehouses and the back office.

footerNote: Costco's merchandise costs include buying, freight and shrink (lost or damaged goods) — the direct cost of what's on the shelves. The quarter is 16 weeks; the fiscal year ended August 31, 2025.

kpis.label: Comparable sales
kpis.note: total company, adjusted for fuel and currency

oneTimers: The year-ago quarter included a one-time $63M tax benefit ($0.14 per share) from a transfer pricing settlement and reserve true-ups — so this year's 11% profit growth was earned against a flattered comparison.
otherDetail: Interest income and other of $215M, less $46M of interest expense.

segments.name: Net sales
segments.note: Everything sold in the warehouses and online.

segments.name: Membership fees
segments.note: Annual memberships — almost pure profit once collected.

takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 6.4% after adjusting for fuel prices and currency — U.S. +6.0%, Canada +8.3%, other international +7.2% — and e-commerce grew 13.5%.
takeaways.title: Shoppers kept coming

takeaways.text: Membership fees rose 14% to $1.72B — money that costs almost nothing to collect and alone covers more than half of the quarter's $3.3B operating profit.
takeaways.title: Membership is the profit engine

takeaways.text: Costco ended the year with 914 warehouses, 629 of them in the U.S. and Puerto Rico, and full-year profit of $8.1B, up 10%.
takeaways.title: Still expanding

verdict: Costco's sales rose 8.0% to $84.4B in its 16-week fourth quarter as comparable sales grew 6.4% — and with $1.72B of nearly cost-free membership fees on top, profit rose 11% to $2.6B.
